recent_articles.title: 24x7 control rooms for disaster management to be set up in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the activation of **Taluk Emergency Operation Centres (TEOCs)** by May 20th to prepare for the monsoon season. The district has received a ₹5 crore disaster relief fund from the **State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)** and additional funds for desilting rivers, cleaning canals, and installing geobags along the Chellanam coast.  Local bodies have been tasked with identifying potential relief camps and furnishing equipment for emergency response.

recent_articles.title: Free vaccination for cervical cancer until May 31 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the final phase of the HPV vaccination campaign against cervical cancer in the district, urging all eligible girls to receive the vaccine before May 31, 2026.  The campaign aims to vaccinate a total of 22,358 girls aged 14 and under, with only 34% currently vaccinated as of the current date. The vaccination facility will cease operation after this deadline.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Counting of votes to be held at three centres in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka**, the **District Election Officer**, announced that vote counting for the Assembly elections held on April 9th in 14 constituencies will take place at three centers: **Cochin University of Science and Technology (Cusat)**, **Union Christian College**, and **Mar Athanasius College**. Counting will begin at 8 a.m., with postal ballots being counted first followed by EVM votes. Initial trends are expected around 10 a.m.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi cites Gujarat BJP chief’s ‘indecent remarks’ against Geniben Thakor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, criticized **the BJP** after its Gujarat unit president made an offensive remark about Congress MP Geniben Thakor.  Gandhi accused the party of having a "distorted mindset" and promoting an "anti-women" ideology, stating that the BJP's actions contradict their claims of women empowerment. **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, Congress general secretary, also condemned the incident, supporting **Geniben Thakor** and highlighting the hypocrisy of the BJP's "Nari Vandana" campaign.

recent_articles.title: Bail order reminder that personal liberty can’t be sacrificed for political vendetta: Pawan Khera - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pawan Khera**, a Congress leader, was granted anticipatory bail by the **Supreme Court** after allegations were made against him regarding his comments on Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma's** wife. The court found that the matter appeared to stem from political rivalry and granted pre-arrest bail with certain conditions.  **Abhishek Singhvi**, along with other legal representatives, defended Khera's liberty amidst threats and intimidation. The Congress hailed the decision as a victory for the rule of law, urging **Sarma** to reconsider his language and apologize.

recent_articles.title: Mukunda Reddy takes charge as I&PR Special Commissioner - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Mukunda Reddy** assumed the role of Special Commissioner and Ex-officio Secretary of the **State Information and Public Relations Department**, succeeding **C.H. Priyanka**.  He emphasized the importance of disseminating government welfare programs to the public, urging officials to follow directives set by Chief Minister **A. Revanth Reddy** and Minister for Revenue, Housing, Information and Public Relations **Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy**. The event was attended by senior officials from the department.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IAS Transfers Apr 2026 | Major reshuffle; Priyanka Ala is Hyderabad Collector - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** government has announced a major reshuffle of IAS officers, transferring and appointing officials across various departments.  **Sanjay Kumar**, Special Chief Secretary in several departments, has been transferred to **Telangana Bhavan** in New Delhi, while **M. Dana Kishore** will replace him as Special Chief Secretary for the **Labour, Employment, Training and Factories (LET&F)** Department. Other key postings include **B. Viziendira** as Secretary to the Social Welfare Department, and **Harichandana Dasari**, Hyderabad Collector, moving to the **LET&F** Department.  The reshuffle also saw several collectors being transferred to different districts.

recent_articles.title: ‘Victim is Dalit, poor every time’: Rahul Gandhi demands probe into Ghazipur rape-murder - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and the **Congress party** are demanding a high-level investigation into the alleged rape and murder of a girl from the Vishwakarma community in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district. **Gandhi** criticized the government for its inaction and demanded immediate justice, protection for the victim's family, and action against police officers involved.  He also questioned Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath**, asking why their rule has made daughters unsafe.

recent_articles.title: Centre's conspiracy to change federal structure defeated; victory of Opposition unity, says Priyanka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, **Congress** general secretary, declared the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill to implement women's reservation as a victory for democracy and opposition unity. She accused the **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Home Minister Amit Shah** of attempting to manipulate the women's reservation law for political gain by linking it with delimitation plans. The bill, which aimed to increase Lok Sabha seats and state assembly representation through 33% reservation for women, failed to secure a two-thirds majority in the Lower House.

recent_articles.title: Chaturvedi’s grumbling over defeat of Women’s Bill’ flies in the face of her party’s stand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena UBT** leader Priyanka Chaturvedi criticized the defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill in the Lok Sabha, expressing her opposition to its inclusion with the Delimitation Bill. **Sanjay Raut**, a Shiv Sena UBT MP, stated that the party opposed the bill because it was presented as a means for the BJP to advance their own agenda. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the opposition's actions, calling them hypocritical and stating that they prioritized politics over progress.

recent_articles.title: India fails to pass bill to boost women’s representation after delimitation row | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian** government failed to pass a bill increasing female representation in parliament after accusations of using it as a cover for electoral map redrawing. The bill, requiring a two-thirds majority, was opposed by the opposition who argued it was an attempt to manipulate the electoral process and unfairly benefit certain states.  This failure marks the first time in 12 years that a constitutional amendment proposed by **Narendra Modi’s Bharatiya Janata party (BJP)** government failed to pass parliament.
